reviews.diagram_kind: pushout square with relative-differential module base-change isomorphism, plus a separate localization comparison
reviews.reason: The central base-change claim is naturally expressed by a pushout square, and a companion localization display would make clear which multiplicative sets are inverted. This can help distinguish the proven isomorphisms from the general functorial comparison, which the item explicitly says need not be an isomorphism. The proof is complete without a diagram, so the opportunity is editorial and remains uncertain rather than a correctness defect.

base_change_square.relation: The square is the pushout defining B'. Label its induced module isomorphism B'⊗_B Ω_{B/A}→Ω_{B'/A'} by (b⊗a')⊗db''↦(b⊗a')d(b''⊗1); inverse sends d(b⊗a')↦a'(1⊗db).

localization_comparison.condition: V⊂A and U⊂B are multiplicative, and the image of V in B lies in U.
localization_comparison.module_isomorphism: U^{-1}Ω_{B/A}≅Ω_{U^{-1}B/V^{-1}A}; the localization derivation sends b/u to u^{-1}db−bu^{-2}du.

proposed_diagram.caution: For arbitrary B→C, show C⊗_B Ω_{B/A}→Ω_{C/A} as a comparison map without an isomorphism label. In the base-change case, composition with Ω_{B'/A}→Ω_{B'/A'} gives the stated isomorphism; the comparison before this composition need not be an isomorphism.

mathematical_check.domains_codomain: The base-change module map has source B'⊗_B Ω_{B/A} and target Ω_{B'/A'}, both B'-modules. The localization isomorphism has source U^{-1}Ω_{B/A} and target Ω_{U^{-1}B/V^{-1}A}, both U^{-1}B-modules. The arbitrary comparison has source C⊗_B Ω_{B/A} and target Ω_{C/A}.
mathematical_check.compositions: In the base-change construction, φψ fixes d(b⊗a') using d(1⊗a')=0, while ψφ fixes (b⊗a')⊗db''. Thus φ and ψ are inverse. For C=B⊗_A A', the arbitrary comparison followed by Ω_{C/A}→Ω_{C/A'} is φ. For C=U^{-1}B with V={1}, the comparison is the localization isomorphism relative to A.
mathematical_check.localization: The condition image(V)⊂U supplies the structure map V^{-1}A→U^{-1}B. The formula d(b/u)=u^{-1}db−bu^{-2}du has the correct negative sign from d(u^{-1})=−u^{-2}du; the proof checks independence of fraction representatives and inverse maps on generators.
mathematical_check.index_sign_convention: No indices occur. The only sign is the negative term in the fraction rule and is consistent with differentiating u·u^{-1}=1.
mathematical_check.result: No mismatch found in the stated maps, domains, codomains, compositions, or localization sign. The arbitrary comparison must remain visibly distinct from the isomorphism claims.
